## {.nostretch}

```{=html}
<div style="width:100%;height:720px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:22px 48px 20px 48px;background:#ffffff;color:#1f2937;font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column;text-align:left;">
  <div style="border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;padding-bottom:6px;margin-bottom:10px;">
    <h1 style="font-size:28px;line-height:1.12;font-weight:720;color:#1f2a44;letter-spacing:-0.1px;margin:0;padding:0;white-space:nowrap;">Feature Engineering &amp; Selection</h1>
  </div>

  <p style="font-size:20px;line-height:1.3;color:#344054;margin:0 0 10px 0;padding:0;max-width:1120px;">We selected 22 survey features that capture workplace, background, and technology-use factors most relevant to job satisfaction.</p>

  <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;flex:1;">

    <div style="width:880px;padding:10px 22px;background:#f8fbff;border:1px solid #d6e4fb;border-radius:14px;box-sizing:border-box;">
      <div style="font-size:19px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:6px;">Feature Selection — 22 features from 170+ columns</div>
      <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2px 28px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.35;color:#344054;">
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Demographics:</strong> Age, EdLevel, WorkExp, YearsCode</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">AI Attitudes:</strong> AISelect, AISent, AIAcc, AIThreat</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Employment:</strong> Employment, RemoteWork, OrgSize, ICorPM</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Compensation:</strong> ConvertedCompYearly</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Geography:</strong> Country, Industry, DevType</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Tools:</strong> ToolCountWork, ToolCountPersonal</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Career Intent:</strong> NewRole, PurchaseInfluence</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Derived:</strong> LeavingScore (ordinal 0–4)</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Work Context:</strong> TechEndorseIntro</div>
        <div></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div style="font-size:19px;line-height:1;color:#315f9f;font-weight:800;">↓</div>

    <div style="width:880px;padding:10px 22px;background:#ffffff;border:1px solid #d7dee8;border-radius:14px;box-sizing:border-box;">
      <div style="font-size:19px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:6px;">Feature Engineering — all parameters from training set only</div>
      <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:4px 20px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.35;color:#344054;">
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Numeric:</strong> median imputation, 99th percentile capping, log-transform salary</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Categorical:</strong> rare categories → "Other" (top-15), missing → "Missing"</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Multi-response:</strong> semicolon-split → binary columns, top-15 options retained</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div style="font-size:19px;line-height:1;color:#315f9f;font-weight:800;">↓</div>

    <div style="width:880px;padding:10px 22px;background:#ffffff;border:1px solid #d7dee8;border-radius:14px;box-sizing:border-box;">
      <div style="font-size:19px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:6px;">Feature Filtering — 3 automated filters</div>
      <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:4px 20px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.35;color:#344054;">
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Near-zero variance:</strong> remove if &gt;95% identical</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">High correlation:</strong> drop one if r &gt; 0.90</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">High missing rate:</strong> remove if &gt;80% missing</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div style="font-size:19px;line-height:1;color:#315f9f;font-weight:800;">↓</div>

    <div style="width:680px;text-align:center;padding:11px 20px;background:#f8fbff;border:1px solid #d6e4fb;border-radius:14px;box-sizing:border-box;">
      <p style="font-size:18px;line-height:1.22;font-weight:750;color:#1f2a44;margin:0;padding:0;">170+ raw → 22 selected → ~120 encoded → filtered → shared feature set for all 5 models</p>
    </div>

  </div>
</div>
```

```{=html}
<div style="width:100%;height:720px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:26px 48px 30px 48px;background:#ffffff;color:#1f2937;font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column;text-align:left;">

  </div>

  <p style="font-size:22px;line-height:1.35;color:#344054;margin:0 0 20px 0;padding:0;max-width:1120px;">Each model was carefully tuned to find its best configuration for predicting job satisfaction.</p>

  <div style="display:grid;gap:0;border-top:1px solid #d7dee8;border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;margin-top:4px;">

    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:280px 1fr 1fr;gap:26px;padding:16px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;align-items:start;">
      <div style="font-size:18px;line-height:1.18;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;">Model</div>
      <div style="font-size:18px;line-height:1.18;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;">What We Tuned</div>
      <div style="font-size:18px;line-height:1.18;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;">Imbalance Strategy</div>
    </div>

    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:280px 1fr 1fr;gap:26px;padding:16px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;align-items:start;">
      <div style="font-size:20px;line-height:1.18;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;">Neural Network</div>
      <div style="font-size:19px;line-height:1.32;color:#344054;">Learning rate, dropout rate, network size</div>
      <div style="font-size:19px;line-height:1.32;color:#344054;">Focal Loss (γ=2) + Neutral ×1.5 class weight</div>
    </div>

    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:280px 1fr 1fr;gap:26px;padding:16px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;align-items:start;">
      <div style="font-size:20px;line-height:1.18;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;">Gradient Boosting</div>
      <div style="font-size:19px;line-height:1.32;color:#344054;">Number of trees, depth, shrinkage, min node size</div>
      <div style="font-size:19px;line-height:1.32;color:#344054;">Square-root class weights</div>
    </div>

    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:280px 1fr 1fr;gap:26px;padding:16px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;align-items:start;">
      <div style="font-size:20px;line-height:1.18;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;">Random Forest</div>
      <div style="font-size:19px;line-height:1.32;color:#344054;">Features per split, split rule, min node size, weight power</div>
      <div style="font-size:19px;line-height:1.32;color:#344054;">Class weights + balanced downsampling</div>
    </div>

    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:280px 1fr 1fr;gap:26px;padding:16px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;align-items:start;">
      <div style="font-size:20px;line-height:1.18;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;">Logistic Regression</div>
      <div style="font-size:19px;line-height:1.32;color:#344054;">Regularisation strength (decay)</div>
      <div style="font-size:19px;line-height:1.32;color:#344054;">Square-root class weights</div>
    </div>

    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:280px 1fr 1fr;gap:26px;padding:16px 0;align-items:start;">
      <div style="font-size:20px;line-height:1.18;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;">Naive Bayes</div>
      <div style="font-size:19px;line-height:1.32;color:#344054;">Laplace smoothing, kernel density estimation</div>
      <div style="font-size:19px;line-height:1.32;color:#344054;">SMOTE oversampling</div>
    </div>

  </div>

  <div style="margin-top:auto;font-size:22px;line-height:1.3;color:#1f2a44;background:#f8fbff;border:1px solid #d6e4fb;padding:13px 18px;border-radius:12px;text-align:center;font-weight:720;box-sizing:border-box;">All models tuned via stratified 3-fold CV with Macro F1 as the selection metric.</div>
</div>
```

```{=html}
<div style="width:100%;height:720px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:26px 48px 30px 48px;background:#ffffff;color:#1f2937;font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column;text-align:left;">

  </div>

  <p style="font-size:22px;line-height:1.35;color:#344054;margin:0 0 20px 0;padding:0;max-width:1120px;">Through iterative feature engineering and loss function design, the neural network learned to recognise all three satisfaction levels.</p>

  <div style="display:grid;gap:0;border-top:1px solid #d7dee8;border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;margin-top:4px;">

      <div style="font-size:18px;line-height:1.18;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;">Stage</div>
      <div style="font-size:18px;line-height:1.18;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;">What Changed</div>

    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:160px 1fr 120px 160px;gap:26px;padding:18px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;align-items:center;">

      <div style="font-size:22px;line-height:1;font-weight:720;color:#344054;text-align:center;">0.24</div>
      <div style="font-size:22px;line-height:1;font-weight:720;color:#e67e22;text-align:center;">37.2%</div>

    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:160px 1fr 120px 160px;gap:26px;padding:18px 0;align-items:center;">
```
